It falls in the same class, **except mobile (field call-out) welding**, which NIC 2025 places under "331199 Repair and maintenance of other fabricated metal products n.e.c. including Mobile welding repair" [S3] p.137. NIC 2008 class 3312 "includes … the provision of welding (e.g. automotive, general) repair services; the repair of agricultural and other heavy and industrial machinery". Under MoSPI survey definitions, repair of machinery counts as **manufacturing**: "This will also include those units which are primarily engaged in providing manufacturing services such as maintenance and repair of industrial, commercial and similar machinery and equipment." - Offline applications go with "a valid caste certificate, income proof, KYC documents" and the agency's checklist.

PMEGP lists its financing institutions as "All Public Sector Banks", "All Regional Rural Banks, Co-operative Banks, Private Sector Scheduled Commercial Banks regulated by RBI" and "Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)". **NSFDC and SCAs are not listed**; the implementing agencies name "National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC)" but not NSFDC. **So the PMEGP bank loan cannot be the NSFDC loan, and a unit already set up with an NSFDC (Government of India) loan is likely shut out of a PMEGP first loan** (our reading) ⚠

items.text: **When D15 does NOT fit:**

- PMEGP, first loan: only for new projects. "Assistance under the Scheme is available only for new projects" [S9] p.2. An existing garage can use only the 2nd-loan (upgradation) route, and only if it was first funded under PMEGP, REGP or MUDRA [S9] pp.2–3.

- PMEGP: not for a unit that already took a Government subsidy, nor for "Existing Units (under PMRY, REGP or any other scheme of Government of India or State Government)" [S9] p.3. A garage already funded by an NSFDC loan is likely excluded (our reading) ⚠.
- PMEGP: the harvester-hiring part of a business may fall on the negative list (pre-revision, [S10] p.36) ⚠.
- PM Vishwakarma: not for the garage business as such, and possibly blocked for 5 years by an NSFDC loan [S14] p.3 ⚠.
